title: Self-update must match the generated installers' receipt location, install dir override, and Windows limits
answers: Why does posthog-cli update on Windows only print an irm command?
Where does the posthog-cli install receipt live?
Update installed a second copy instead of replacing my CLI
body:
`cli/src/update.rs` must mirror what the cargo-dist generated installers do:
- `receipt_path`: check `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` first on ALL platforms, then `LOCALAPPDATA` on Windows or `~/.config` elsewhere, joined with `posthog-cli/posthog-cli-receipt.json`. Checking only LOCALAPPDATA misclassifies XDG installs as Unknown.
- `run_installer` must set `POSTHOG_CLI_INSTALL_DIR` to the receipt's prefix; otherwise the installer writes to its default `~/.posthog`, leaves the running binary stale, and the command still reports success.
- Windows: install.ps1 uses `Copy-Item` over the exe, which fails while it is running, so `InstallMethod::ScriptWindows` prints `irm <install.ps1> | iex` rather than self-updating.
- Versions come from `posthog-cli/stable/dist-manifest.json` (`releases[0].app_version`), never the GitHub API; check is equality, not semver.
- Re-verify against the published installer if cargo-dist is upgraded.

Version checks use posthog-cli/stable/dist-manifest.json releases[0].app_version by equality, never GitHub API or semver comparison. Re-verify against published installers if cargo-dist is upgraded.
